rationale: E3 (static INT8 QDQ encoder + dynamic INT8 decoder) matched FP32 TF SMILES exactly on daidzein/caffeine fixtures and was faster in local CPU runs than E1, but encoder calibration used only 2 fixture images (in-sample). E1 is calibration-free with the same exact parity on tested fixtures and is the safer default until a larger calibration/golden set is evaluated. E2 static decoder failed parity; E4 FP16 decoder has a CPU runtime broadcast error in attention.

calibration.note: Minimal fixture-only calibration; expand with representative printed structure images before promoting static variants.

fp32.parity: exact vs TF on tested fixtures

e2-static-int8-qdq.parity: failed (garbage SMILES, incomplete behavior) on tested fixtures

e4-fp16.parity: not runnable on CPU (decoder attention broadcast runtime error)
